column1: # tools/ledger_overrides.tsv -- a verdict row's description where the commit
# that closed the verdict was subjected outside `tools/ledger.py`'s subject
# rule. S334.
# The rule reads a row's run and description from the closing commit's
# subject, and history is never rewritten, so a subject in the wrong form
# reads out wrong at every regeneration. A row here replaces that commit's
# description, and its run when the row carries one, and nothing else; the
# numbers and the class still come from its result block. Written as the
# table's other rows read.
# Columns. `sha` is the closing commit's full sha, `git log --format=%H`: an
# abbreviation is unique only in the history it was taken from. `what` is the
# description the row prints. `by` is the step or decision that recorded it.
# `run`, optional (S337), is the run id the row prints, in the form the rule
# reads (S<nnn> and any ` v<n>`, ` leg <n>`, ` F<nn>`); a row without it keeps
# the run the subject gives.
# `tools/ledger.py` refuses to print on a short or repeated sha, an empty
# `what` or one carrying `|`, a `by` that is no S<nnn> or DEC-<nnn>, a `run`
# that is no run id or names another step than the subject's, a sha that
# closes no verdict the ledger prints, a sha
# whose subject already reads out cleanly under the rule, and a row that
# changes nothing the rule reads -- so a row cannot restyle a clean subject,
# and the file holds only commits that need it. Its header lists the same.
# 1ffc96e, S122's H1, was subjected "Ship S122's fitted king safety family on
# its H1 (S122, DEC-353)" and read "Ship 's fitted king safety family on its
# H1 (S122, DEC-353)"; its neighbours read "the passed pawn family", "the pawn
# structure family", "the threat family".
# S337, the four others. e47eb4a, S289's H0, "Revert S289's null-move table
# guard on its H0 (DEC-309)", read "Revert 's null-move table guard on its H0
# (DEC-309)"; S292's row beside it reads "the narrowed null-move guard".
# b9f5b96, S112's no verdict, "Record S112's no-verdict at the cap: a zero, the
# code kept for S022", read its outcome, "no-verdict at the cap: a zero, the
# code kept for S022"; its body names what was measured, "per-move futility in
# quiescence at its seeds", as S113's row reads "ProbCut stays at its seeds".
# 775dafd and 7f46c0c, "Record S022 verdict 1's H0: the exchange gate stays"
# and "Record S023 verdict 1's H0: capture history in the margins reverts",
# read run S022 and S023 with "1's H0: " left on the description, since
# "verdict 1" is no qualifier the rule reads. Their runs are each step's
# verdict 1: S022's log is S022_v1_sprt.log, its candidate a97bc1a "(S022 v1)"
# and its sibling row S022 v2; S023's candidate adb5d78 "(S023 v1)", its done
# stamp "verdict 1 of two (DEC-273)", verdict 2 never run.
